prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重复值 · 审批流水 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "单号" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 64px
  col 2: header "申请人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "金额" · longest unbreakable word 71px · one-line width 71px
  col 5: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "审批意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示审批流水，帮助读者按单号查找申请，并了解金额、审批状态和处理意见。","reading":"读者会逐行关联申请人与申请类型，再比较金额和状态；待审批或已驳回的记录尤其需要结合审批意见阅读。长意见会决定部分行的高度，同一行中姓名、类型或状态的适度换行可以利用这些高度。","groups":["单号、申请人和类型共同标识一笔申请。","金额是需要跨行比较的数值列。","状态与审批意见共同说明审批进度和处理结果。"],"keep_intact":["金额的整数、逗号和小数应保持在同一行。","单号应尽可能保持完整，至少避免拆开其中的连续编号。","姓名、状态和申请类型应尽可能保持词语完整。"],"may_wrap":["审批意见可按自然语义换行，长意见所在行可以更高。","空间不足时，申请类型可按词组换行；姓名和状态也可换行，但逐字竖排会妨碍扫描。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [59, 43, 51, 92, 43, 71] · table 360×1048px · row heights [83, 106, 106, 106, 222, 106, 106, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 4/6 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [59, 43, 51, 92, 51, 63] · table 360×1211px · row heights [83, 106, 129, 106, 315, 106, 106, 106, 153] · column headers wrapped 4/6 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [59, 51, 51, 92, 51, 55] · table 360×1211px · row heights [83, 106, 129, 106, 315, 106, 106, 106, 153] · column headers wrapped 4/6 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"金额保持单行，便于跨行比较；类型按两个字一组换行，审批意见也有一定的横向阅读空间。","problems":"申请人、状态和部分表头逐字竖排，单号分成两行；长审批意见仍形成很高的行，行内其他单元格留下大片空白。","cause":"申请人和状态各43px，仅有22px文本空间；单号59px不足以容纳完整单号。意见列71px只容纳较短的文本片段。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"金额仍完整，类型保持较整齐的两字换行；状态列比r2A略宽。","problems":"状态仍基本逐字排列，意见比r2A更窄，驳回原因被切成更多短行，第4条记录因此明显拉高，其他列的空白也随之增加。","cause":"状态列51px提供30px文本空间，仍不足以容纳两个15px汉字以外的余量；意见列从71px减至63px，长意见的换行显著增加。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"金额保持单行，类型列的两字分组有助于识别申请类型。","problems":"申请人和状态仍有竖排，意见列极窄，长意见读起来像一条竖带；第4条记录过高，破坏逐行浏览的节奏。","cause":"意见列只有55px，扣除内边距和边框后仅剩34px；申请人和状态各51px，仍不足以完整容纳三个汉字。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"意见优先","widths":[59,43,51,92,37,77],"change":"以r2A为基础，把状态列收窄6px并全部交给意见列。状态本已逐字换行，尝试在维持金额和类型可读性的同时，让长意见获得更多横向空间。"},{"name":"进一步扩展意见","widths":[59,37,51,92,37,83],"change":"再从申请人列取6px给意见列。申请人和状态都接受逐字换行，换取意见列约四个汉字的文本空间，检验长意见和高行是否明显改善。"},{"name":"姓名与意见折中","widths":[59,51,51,92,37,69],"change":"加宽申请人列，收窄状态列，并保留接近r2A的意见宽度。检验两字姓名和申请人表头的改善是否值得意见列稍微收窄。"}]}
